nodes.name: globalTabsActions.ts
nodes.summary: Write-only Jotai action atoms for global tab state, providing add/remove/set-active/update operations for browser tabs, terminal sessions, editor repos, document files, workspace sessions, and shortcuts, all mutating the shared navigationSidebarTabsAtom with FIFO eviction per tab type.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jotai write-only atoms (atom(null, (get, set, ...) => ...)) as action creators, a common alternative to Redux-style reducers/dispatchers; removeTerminalSessionAtom additionally invokes the Tauri backend (close_pty) as a side effect.

nodes.name: globalTabsTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript interfaces (BrowserTab, TerminalSession, EditorRepo, DocumentFile, WorkspaceSession, ShortcutItem, GlobalTabsState) plus per-tab-type max-size constants and utility functions (favicon URL, site name derivation, FIFO eviction) used across the global tabs state module.

nodes.name: navigationSidebarTabsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Core Jotai atom holding the navigation sidebar's persisted tab state (atomWithStorage under the 'orgii-global-tabs' key) plus read-only derived atoms for the active browser tab, terminal session, editor repo, document file, workspace session, shortcut, and aggregate tab counts.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately does not re-export the write action atoms from globalTabsActions.ts to avoid a circular import, per the file's header comment.

nodes.name: getFaviconUrl
nodes.summary: Builds a favicon URL for a given site URL using Google's public favicon service, returning undefined for missing or unparseable URLs.

nodes.name: getSiteNameFromUrl
nodes.summary: Derives a human-readable site name (e.g., 'google.com' -> 'Google') from a URL's hostname, falling back to 'New Tab' when the URL is missing or invalid.

nodes.name: evictOldest
nodes.summary: Generic FIFO eviction helper that trims an array of timestamped, activatable items down to maxSize, always preserving active items and evicting the oldest inactive ones first.
